title: Deployment Operations Manager - Groningen Hub
description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

 

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from companies like Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta and Google DeepMind. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural.

 

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week.

 

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/and company https://www.monumental.co/about/. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, https://www.youtube.com/@buildmonumental Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2-Q2F0Fcx4A, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DOo8n19XEns.

 

About the role

Monumental is unique in that we’re completely vertically-integrated. We design and build our own hardware and software, we manufacture the robots in-house, and we deploy them on construction sites ourselves, with our own team, operating as a subcontractor.

 

We build cutting-edge technology, but we sell the old-fashioned way: by showing up, walking the site, and earning trust in person. If you’re looking for a remote-first role, this isn’t it. Onsite construction usually starts before sunrise on a site in a town you'd otherwise never visit.

 

Construction is one of the most chaotic industries there is, and we're deploying hardware and software into it in a way that hasn't happened before. Robots fail, contractors change the plan, and it's on you to keep the build moving forward no matter what.

 

We call these projects deployments, with more robots, more people, and now in new markets as we scale from the Netherlands into the UK and US. So far our Operators, Deployment Operations Manager and fleet of 150+ robots that have laid bricks for 100+ homes, a school, a community centre, a hotel, and 150+ m of canal walls.

 

In practice the job is five jobs in one: site foreman, operations manager, account executive, analyst, and project manager. You make the build plan, deploy yourself with your team on site as a subcontractor, manage the contractor relationship, and take responsibility for delivering quality walls, finished on time.

 

The other half of the job happens back at our facility. Managing your deployment's P&L, planning the build plan for the next one, and reconsidering the operational systems to improve your margin. You own the delivery, and you own translating the friction you see on site back to our R&D team.

 

This is a very entrepreneurial role - you'll get an extraordinary amount of autonomy, if you've spent the last couple of years building something operationally messy - startup, scale-up, running your own company, or in a heavy industry where the plan changes routinely and y. You'll run one deployment first, then several in parallel. Run it like it's your own business, because in practice it is.

 

What you'll do

- Plan the logistics of a deployment: decide how many and which robots and humans to send, coordinate with other subcontractors, and build both a day-to-day operational plan and a view of how your decisions move our unit economics.

title: Model Optimization Engineer
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Model Optimization Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $150,000-$175,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an Model Optimization Engineer to focus on extracting maximum throughput, minimizing latency, and reducing cost across training and inference workloads for large neural network systems. The role spans the full stack from low-level kernel optimization to distributed system tuning, requiring deep understanding of GPU architecture, model parallelism, memory management, and compiler-level optimization. The ideal candidate has demonstrated impact on production AI workloads, with strong instrumentation and measurement discipline that enables rigorous, data-driven optimization decisions. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners - product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders - to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

• Six or more years of experience in performance engineering, ML systems, or HPC.

• Strong proficiency in Python and C++.

• Hands-on experience optimizing deep learning workloads on modern GPUs.

• Deep understanding of distributed training and inference techniques.

• Experience with profiling tools across CPU, GPU, and distributed systems.

• Familiarity with model compression techniques and their accuracy implications.

• Strong grasp of memory hierarchies, communication primitives, and parallelism strategies.

• Excellent measurement, debugging, and analytical reasoning skills.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience optimizing LLM inference at production scale.

• Contributions to vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, DeepSpeed, or similar projects.

• Familiarity with custom kernel authoring in Triton or CUTLASS.

• Experience with FinOps for AI workloads.

• Publications or talks on AI systems performance.

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region - this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
The Role
BJAK is building a Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia. As a Technical Product Manager, you’ll own a product vertical end to end-such as payments and expense management, remittance, insurance, or wealth and trading-from strategy, outcomes, and roadmap through to the technical design and delivery of the systems behind it.
This is a product where real money moves, mistakes are immediately visible, and licensing, compliance, and third-party rails are core product constraints-not considerations around the edges.
We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where a model can genuinely improve an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted when money is involved.
What you'll be doing

• Own a vertical end-to-end - outcomes and metrics, a backlog prioritised by value / risk / dependency / strategic priority, acceptance criteria crisp enough to build and test against.

• Shape the technical design with engineering - system boundaries, money-movement correctness (idempotency, ledgering, reconciliation), third-party-rail reliance and rail-down behaviour, failure/retry/refund paths, security, latency, scalability, recovery.

• Make hard trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability and UX - and defend them to an engineering, compliance or ops lead who pushes back.

• Treat regulated constraints as first-class product inputs - licensing scope, CDD/KYC and limits, sanctions/PEP screening, transaction monitoring, data residency and privacy. Know which are hard launch gates and which are forward-readiness.

• Apply AI where it earns its place - define what it's allowed to decide, where a human stays in the loop, how it's evaluated, and what it does when unsure. Every AI-surfaced number traces back to a real record.

• Ship against external gates - build feature-complete behind flags; go live per rail as each partner and regulatory gate clears.

• Work across Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance/Reconciliation.

What you'll need

• Product leadership - significant experience owning a complex technical product end-to-end; strong judgement and decisiveness under ambiguity; ability to balance ambition against technical, regulatory and operational reality; can hold their own with senior engineers.

• Technical foundation - solid system design (boundaries, datastores, queues/workflows, APIs, failure modes, consistency under concurrency); comfort reading, reviewing and challenging design docs; can sketch an architecture and a sequence. No production code, but technical enough that engineers don't have to simplify.

• Domain - experience in a regulated / high-consequence domain (payments, banking, remittance, insurance, …) or demonstrable fast-ramp ability; understands why money movement is different (correctness over convenience, irreversible states

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l'état de l'art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Application Software Team

Our Application Software US team brings Wayve’s autonomous driving technology onto customer vehicle platforms, driving localisation and advancing our capabilities for the US market. Working at the intersection of our AI software stack, embedded systems and automotive hardware, the team enables reliable performance across diverse systems-on-chip (SoCs) and operating systems.

We’re seeking an exceptional technical leader to build and lead this high-impact team. This is a unique opportunity to shape our AV capabilities in the US from the ground up, hiring and mentoring engineers while leading the bring-up and early validation of our AI software stack on customer hardware.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

- Build and lead an engineering team in the US, hiring and mentoring top talent while providing hands-on technical leadership.

- Lead software bring-up on customer hardware platforms, such as NVIDIA DRIVE and Qualcomm Ride, including porting and configuring Linux, QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR environments.

- Validate drivers, middleware and boot-time configurations, partnering with OEM and Tier 1 teams to resolve hardware-specific integration issues.

- Collaborate with Verification & Release teams to integrate hardware into CI/CD, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) and test infrastructure, automating setup, flashing, health checks and test execution.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

You’ll make Wayve’s AI software stack run reliably on customer hardware, from initial platform bring-up through early validation. Working closely with customer partners and internal engineering teams, you’ll establish repeatable integration and testing workflows that support efficient development across automotive platforms.

- You have 8+ years of experience in embedded or automotive software development, ideally with hands-on platform bring-up experience, and strong proficiency in C/C++, Bash and Python.

- You bring deep knowledge of embedded Linux, including Yocto, systemd, bootloaders and device trees, plus familiarity with configuring and debugging QNX and Adaptive AUTOSAR on target hardware.

As AI search and conversational agents replace traditional web search and browsing, Scrunch helps marketing teams rethink how their products and services are discovered and surfaced on AI platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more-working with AI platforms, not against them. This shift represents the biggest change to marketing since the dawn of the internet.
Today, more than 500 paying brands-including Fortune 500 companies like Lenovo, category-defining brands like Akamai, ADP, Lenovo and breakout startups like Clerk-use the platform.

As an Enterprise AE at Scrunch, you’ll lead complex sales cycles addressing one of the most urgent challenges facing CMOs today: how brands show up in an AI-first world. You’ll own deals end to end-from first conversation through close-navigating multi-stakeholder buying groups, longer sales cycles, and 6-7 figure ACVs.
You’ll operate with autonomy and urgency while partnering closely with marketing and product to help build a repeatable enterprise motion in a fast-moving, competitive category.
What You’ll Do

• Own the full enterprise sales cycle from sourcing and discovery through deal strategy, negotiation, and close

• Manage and close inbound leads while also driving outbound prospecting into mid-market and enterprise accounts

• Run complex, multi-threaded sales processes with senior stakeholders across marketing, brand, product, and executive teams

• Sell strategic solutions, not features-help CMOs and VPs solve visibility, performance, and discovery challenges in an AI-first world

• Execute 6-7 figure deals with longer sales cycles (3-6+ months), navigating ambiguity and evolving buyer needs

• Continuously research the market, identifying target accounts, competitive dynamics, and emerging trends to sharpen your approach

What You’ll Bring

• 7+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including significant experience as an Enterprise Account Executive

• Proven success closing complex 6- and 7-figure deals with multi-stakeholder buying groups

• Strong executive presence, with the ability to build credibility and trust with CMOs, VPs, and senior marketing leaders

• Customer-centric mindset, with a passion for understanding buyer needs and delivering high-impact solutions

• Exceptional communication skills, comfortable articulating value clearly via phone, email, Zoom, and in-person meetings

• Highly organized and goal-driven, with excellent time management, follow-up, and a track record of exceeding quota

• Tech-savvy, experienced with CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot), sales tooling, and modern SaaS/AI products

• Deep curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, and how buyers are adapting their strategies

• Ability and willingness to travel periodically within your territory and to Scrunch offices

Nice to Have

• Experience selling into brand, SEO, martech, or AI ecosystems

Scrunch is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people of all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and identities. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Every product decision at ComPsych eventually reaches someone in a hard moment - a mental health crisis, a leave of absence, a benefit they need but don't fully understand. We're making our product development lifecycle AI-native from discovery through delivery, working closely with Engineering and Design end to end. An overview of this role

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Change Record team within GitLab’s Source Code stage . You'll work remotely from the United Kingdom or Poland.

• Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.

• Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.

• Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.

What you’ll bring

• Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and G

title: Narrative Writer
description:
About us
At Longdue , we’re dedicated to crafting narrative-first, psychologically deep, RPGs.
We focus on creating games with real depth-whether in our characters, environments or the stories we tell. We’re here to challenge your choices, your morality-everything you think you know. We’re here to make games where decisions matter and have consequences. We want to build on the legacy of classic story-driven RPGs while reviving the genre meaningfully.
Our goal is simple: to become a trusted name in the greater RPG canon.
With talent from the original Disco Elysium team and veterans from the wider industry, including Bungie and Rockstar, we’re creating something new-a project that resonates, challenges, and leaves a lasting mark.
We’re Longdue , and we’re finally here.
The role
We are seeking a talented Writer to help craft an immersive, multi-layered RPG experience for our computer RPG in its early stages. The gameplay will focus on dialogue choices, character interactions, and a branching story where every decision has consequences. You’ll be responsible for creating narrative content that combines psychological depth, philosophical musings, and a richly evocative world that brings player choices to life.
Responsibilities

• Write compelling dialogue and narrative events that deepen the connection between characters and the world.

• Develop a rich story that explores the interplay between the physical environment and the protagonist’s mental journey.

• Contribute to building a universe awash in contrasts, where environments from two interconnected worlds reflect each other in direct and mysterious ways.

• Collaborate with designers, artists, programmers, and your colleagues in narrative to ensure the story is deeply integrated with gameplay, emphasising role-play and skill-based checks inspired by TTRPG mechanics.

Requirements

Must-have

• Proven experience in writing for video games, especially RPGs or interactive fiction. Creative writing or screenwriting experience is also highly valued.

• Ability to craft a story that explores themes of psychogeography, human psychology, and the dark corners of society. We want characters and dialogue that are multifaceted, flawed, and profoundly human.

• Ability to develop environments that reflect the character’s internal state, exploring connections between space, mood, and psychology.

• An interest in delving into cosmic mysteries, existential questions, and philosophical ideas about society, power, and individual purpose.

• Capable of working within a creative team, taking feedback constructively, and contributing to the shared vision of the project.

Nice to have

• Familiarity with narrative-heavy RPGs.

• Experience in crafting non-combat gameplay loops that revolve around storytelling, exploration, and character development.

• Knowledge of TTRPG-inspired mechanics such as dialogue reels, dice-based checks, or psychological skill systems.

• Experience writing in media other than video games.

Benefits
Creative freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.
Thought-provoking project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.
Flexible working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.
Join Us: We’re here to make narrative-first, psychologically deep RPGs. If you’re passionate about storytelling, design, and pushing the boundaries of what games can be, Longdue is the place for you.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the transactional database market. The PlanetScale platform offers both Postgres and Vitess clusters. Vitess, an open-source database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL, enables businesses to efficiently handle large-scale data workloads - without sacrificing developer experience.
PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for early members of our Sales team that can form deep partnerships with our prospects and customers to help them adopt and succeed on the next generation of database infrastructure.
What's the job to be done?

• Partner with Sales and Customer Engineering throughout the pre-sales and post-sales journey as the technical expert helping customers solve their most challenging database problems.

• Lead technical discovery to match customers’ business and technical objectives with PlanetScale ’s offerings.

• Design and execute proof of value timelines that deliver on agreed upon business outcomes and success criteria.

• Design database migration strategies and work hands-on with customers to execute migrations to PlanetScale 's PostgreSQL and Vitess platforms.

• Assess workloads, analyze performance requirements, and recommend architecture, sizing, and optimization strategies.

• Build tools, scripts, and automation that accelerate migrations and improve customer onboarding.

• Create educational content including documentation, guides, blog posts, workshops, and videos.

• Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and shape the platform.

These attributes best describe you…

• You have deep expertise in database systems including replication, high availability, sharding, performance tuning, and migration strategies.

• You're equally comfortable presenting architecture designs to executives and writing scripts to automate migration tasks.

• You thrive in customer-facing situations and translate technical concepts into business value for diverse audiences.

• You're self-motivated and can manage multiple engagements simultaneously with minimal oversight.

• You enjoy creating content and sharing knowledge through various formats.

• You're comfortable with occasional travel (less than 20%).

What you will need

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL in production, including operations, performance tuning, and troubleshooting OR

• 5+ years of experience supporting customers with MySQL or PostgreSQL workloads where you advised on operations, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

• Experience working with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, or OCI)

• Proven success in customer-facing technical roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

• Strong understanding of database migration strategies and tooling

• Experience evaluating database solutions including architecture reviews, capacity planning, and performance analysis

• Ability to write scripts and tools in Python, Go, or JavaScript

• Experience creating technical content such as documentation, tutorials, or blog posts

What else will help you be successful

• Experience with AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) or logical replication tools

• Knowledge of Vitess, database sharding, or distributed database systems

• Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation

• Contributions to open-source projects or active participation in database communities

• Public speaking experience at conferences or meetups

title: Senior Developer Advocate - Volcano
description:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

About the Role

Volcano (volcano.dev http://volcano.dev) is a cloud for apps built with coding agents. You tell Claude Code, Cursor or Codex what you want, and it sets up the database, auth, functions, storage, realtime and deploys on Volcano without a trip through a dashboard. Most platforms were designed around a person in a console and added agent support later. We started from the agent.

We're a small team and launched publicly in September 2026. Volcano is incubated by Kong and runs as its own company with its own brand.

This role sits between engineering and the developers we build for. You'll build on Volcano constantly, show people what it can do, and bring back what you learn so the product gets better.

What you'll do

- Own the Volcano Cookbook: recipes that build real apps on Volcano with tools developers already use, written up with the code, the decisions and the gotchas.

- Build templates and examples people can deploy in one step.

- Make video, including YouTube, streams and short demos.

- Run Volcano hackathons, show up at others, and decide which sponsorships are worth doing.

- Work with the companies whose tools appear in our recipes on joint content.

- Spend time where developers ask questions, in Discord, on X and on GitHub, and bring what you hear back to the team.

- Build the tooling and workflows that let a small team publish more without the quality slipping.

- Be customer zero. You'll hit rough edges before users do, and engineers should be able to act on your reports.

Who you'll bring

- You've built things in public in the last year and can show us what you shipped and how you told people about it.

- You've done 0-to-1 work: started a company, joined one early, or launched something from nothing.

- You're technical and fluent with coding agents. You don't need to be a database or infrastructure expert, but you can build a working app with Claude Code or similar, debug it when it breaks, and explain what happened.

- You write well. You use AI in your own workflow, and you can tell when output reads like slop.

- You like explaining things, whether to a room, a camera or a thread of skeptical replies.

- Engineers trust you on technical accuracy.

Bonus Points

- An existing developer audience

- Hackathon organizing experience

- Experience with developer platforms like Vercel, Supabase, Neon or Cloudflare.

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic - on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com http://www.konghq.com.

• Experience supporting CPQ, quote-to-cash, pricing administration, commercial operations, or related workflows preferred.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is transforming how legal and professional services work gets done. As AI moves from answering questions to carrying out complex workflows, the engineering challenge expands: every interaction depends on systems that can handle sensitive data, stream results, coordinate work, and stay fast and reliable under growing demand. Backend Platform builds the shared foundations that make this possible.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the team shaping how backend software is built at Harvey. Your team owns the frameworks, libraries, and core abstractions that product engineers use every day-from database access and caching to request handling, observability, and safe context propagation. A better abstraction here can accelerate every product team. A stronger default can prevent an entire class of production failures. The impact of your decisions compounds across the engineering organization.

The next chapter is especially compelling. As both engineers and coding agents contribute more software, we need a platform that makes the right patterns easy to use and the wrong ones difficult to introduce. You’ll help define that foundation: clear architectural boundaries, reusable building blocks, and automated safeguards that let teams ship with confidence. You’ll tackle deep systems problems while building an engineering experience people love.

This is a technical leadership role with room to shape both the platform and the team. You’ll hire and develop exceptional engineers, set the technical direction, and stay close to architecture and code. If you enjoy turning hard, recurring problems into simple tools that make everyone around you more effective, this is an opportunity to do it at the center of Harvey’s growth.

- Lead and grow the Backend Platform team. Hire, coach, and retain exceptional engineers, giving them clear ownership, meaningful technical challenges, and room to grow.

- Build the next generation of Harvey’s backend foundations. Guide the design of shared frameworks for database access, session management, caching, request handling, and streaming-with clear interfaces and strong defaults.

- Help Harvey scale through better architecture. Work with Infrastructure to evolve how applications use databases, replicas, and new storage systems, making those capabilities accessible without requiring every product team to solve the same problems.

title: Sr/Staff Product Manager, Research Products
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Open to hiring remote across the US - we also have offices in NYC, San Francisco, and Seattle

It gives the right person a GM-like mandate to drive product decisions end-to-end, in a way that’s unique for a company of our scale.

We’re looking for a Product Manager to build the AI tools our customers will rely on. You have a real engineering or quantitative foundation and a track record of shipping products. You can take the state-of-the-art systems our research team builds and turn them into products that creators love.

You’ll deeply understand what users want, what’s technically possible, and what’s strategic for our business. You’ll be the bridge between our users and our internal teams, so we ship our models and products with the most value for Runway’s creators.

This role is a fundamental and critical part of the team at a market-defining company in its early stages.

What you’ll do

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for your area, from early model development through launch, pricing, and go-to-market

- Partner with research to shape what gets built, translating customer needs and model capabilities into clear product requirements and priorities

- Work closely with engineering and design to ship new products and continuously improve existing ones, making sound technical tradeoffs along the way

- Define and analyze product metrics, run A/B tests, and use data (including your own SQL and Python analysis) to validate pain points and prioritize features

- Talk with users weekly to uncover use cases and turn feedback into product decisions

- Drive pricing and GTM strategy in partnership with business teams

What you’ll need

- 4+ years of product management experience, including taking products from zero to one

- A strong technical foundation, typically demonstrated by things like the following:

- A degree in a technical or quantitative field such as computer science, HCI, math, statistics, or physics

- Professional experience writing code before the LLM codegen era (e.g., as a software engineer, data scientist, data analyst, or technical founder who built and bootstrapped a product)

- Hands-on fluency with SQL, Python, AI code generation tools, and version control best practices

- Working knowledge of current ML capabilities and products, and the ability to discuss tradeoffs with researchers and engineers

- Experience in fast-moving teams, with comfort operating amid ambiguity

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Nice to have

- Experience with generative AI, creative tools, or media products

- Experience owning pricing or GTM for a product

title: Senior Software Engineer, Perceptual Calibration
description:
About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

Rivet is looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to own perceptual calibration for our next-generation AR wearables and devices running Android and embedded Linux. Accurate camera, IMU, and display calibration is what every tracking and display experience rests on: it keeps tracking stable, overlays registered to the real world, and rendering comfortable. This role spans calibration algorithms, calibration station and process design, and factory deployment, taking calibration from the lab bench to factory production lines. You will work closely with hardware, mechanical, robotics, perception, and manufacturing teams to deliver calibration that is accurate, repeatable, and efficient at production scale.

Responsibilities

- Build computer vision and signal processing algorithms that calibrate the geometric intrinsics, extrinsics, and time offsets of cameras, IMUs, and XR displays.

- Develop perceptual calibration processes for Rivet’s range of wearables and devices, covering calibration station design (sensor and target selection, metrology hardware requirements) and controlled data capture conditions.

- Deploy data capture processes and calibration binaries to factory sites, working with contract manufacturers (CMs) through bring-up, ramp, and mass production.

- Set factory calibration limits using Gage Repeatability & Reproducibility (GR&R) studies and Design of Experiments (DOE), and establish failure analysis processes backed by automated and agentic diagnosis and documented runbooks.

- Reduce calibration cycle time through software profiling and refinement, additional or alternative station hardware, and process pipelining.

- Develop tooling, visualization, and debugging workflows for end-to-end validation of perceptual calibration, including lab verification of factory calibration results.

- Partner with hardware, mechanical, optical, and electrical engineering, robotics, perception, and manufacturing teams to set calibration requirements, design-for-calibration tolerances, and station specifications, and to deliver calibrated products end-to-end.

Requirements

- Proven hands-on experience shipping camera, IMU, and/or display calibration solutions into production devices, from lab prototype through factory ramp.

- Demonstrated hands-on ability to debug calibration failures, with a deep understanding of both the front-end perception (target detection, feature extraction, data association) and back-end optimization (sensor models, nonlinear least squares, observability) components of geometric calibration pipelines.

- PhD + at least 3 years (or MS + at least 7 years) of relevant professional experie
